commentary_title: Vessel repositioning drives uptick in VLGC spot rates
commentary_summary: Spot rates on the AG-Japan and US-Japan routes rose 26% and 13% WoW, respectively, driven by fleet reshuffing following 1-year pause on retaliatory tariffs, USTR and the tightened vessel supply. | The spike is supply-led, while demand remains weak amid poor Asian petchem margins. Declining laden tonnage at anchor in India and China confirms the trend. | Weak demand fundamentals and ample supply have already anchored a decline in Saudi CP benchmarks narrowing US-Middle East arbitrage. | LPG shipping to face volatile period if Middle East-Asia flows improve on sliding LPG prices, which will reduce tonne-mile demand and cap VLGC spot rates.
